notes.title: Bug Fixes and Visual Enhancements
notes.content:
Minor bugs have been fixed.
Fixed an issue where workers would not resume their tasks from the previous day.
Added lighting inside factories for better visibility.
Fixed the issue where items in storage appeared to float in the air.
Corrected some errors in production recipes.
New Features and Improvements

Added dynamic markers to indicate where machines drop items.
Introduced neon indicators on machines to show correct and incorrect items clearly.

notes.title: Bug Fix & UI Update
notes.content: Minor bugs have been fixed, UI designs have been updated, and sound effects have been added.

notes.title: Minor Update: Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Your feedback helps us make the game better, so please let us know if you encounter any issues. Thank you for your continued support and enjoy the game!

Best regards,
Simnetic Game
